result_text:
`analyzeLandscape` now works as a second name for `updateLandscape`. It compiles (`mvn -o -pl cli compile`), but I didn't run any tests or try the command end to end.

- **`cli/.../Commands.java`**: I added `ANALYZE_LANDSCAPE` and its description. The description says it is the landscape counterpart of the analysis commands and the same as `updateLandscape`. It is also listed in the no-argument usage overview, using the same options as `updateLandscape`.
- **`cli/.../CommandLineInterface.java`**: `analyzeLandscape` goes through the same code path as `updateLandscape`, so the options behave identically. `-help` prints the usage of whichever name you typed.
- **`README.md`**: it had no command descriptions, so I added a short "Commands" section that lists `analyzeLandscape` and notes that `updateLandscape` is the same command, kept for existing scripts.
